job_description.title: Head of Outcome Engineering
job_description.summary: Lead engineering, delivery, and team-building for TrueFoundry's enterprise outcomes initiatives. Own technical delivery of GenAI-powered solutions across verticals; build and lead a high-performing engineering + applied ML team; develop domain-aligned technical frameworks, reusable components, and solution templates.
responsibilities: Oversee delivery of ML/GenAI solutions; production-grade, scalable, referenceable
Act as technical sponsor for top accounts and POCs
Build accelerators, templates, and tools (Cognita apps, domain evals, RAG pipelines)
Codify delivery best practices into reusable playbooks
Channel technical feedback into product roadmap with TrueFoundry platform teams
Hire, grow, and manage engineering talent pipeline; own resourcing, forecasting, execution
requirements: Built and led Applied ML teams at large tech companies or startups
Hands-on with ML, GenAI, systems design; opinionated about repeatable AI delivery architectures
Measures success by repeatability and product-integration of delivery
job_description.company_context: Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Products: AI Gateway (control plane — Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) and AI Deploy (Kubernetes-based unified compute). Customers: CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, Zscaler.
